units.source_text: 金花心里有恐惧又害怕，她笔直的站在桌前，问道。

en.t: Jinhua was filled with fear and anxiety; she stood straight in front of the table and asked.

units.source_text: 那人摇头示意自己听不懂汉语，随后一手取下叼着的烟斗，语速飞快且流利的说出一段听不懂的外语。

en.t: The man shook his head to show that he did not understand Chinese; then with one hand he removed the pipe from his mouth and spoke a stretch of incomprehensible foreign language rapidly and fluently.

units.source_text: 金花听不懂，摇了摇头，耳朵上的翡翠耳环在灯光下熠熠生辉。

en.t: Jinhua did not understand and shook her head; the jade earrings on her ears glittered under the light.
